headline: Mallcom India submits scrutinizer's report and voting results for AGM
hook: AGM voting results submitted to exchanges
summary: Mallcom (India) Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results from its Annual General Meeting held on September 29, 2026, to the stock exchanges. This is a routine compliance filing required under SEBI regulations. For an Indian retail investor, this administrative update carries no direct financial or operational impact.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance update with no direct impact on share price
